name: muse-illustration
description: Turn poems, imagery, or a one-line spark of inspiration into illustrations or posters, using a growing built-in style library.

description_i18n.en: Turn poems, imagery, or a one-line spark of inspiration into illustrations or posters, using a growing built-in style library.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把诗词、词句、意象或一句话灵感，转化为插画或海报；内置可成长的风格库（风格配方 = 正向提示词 + 负向约束 + 参考图 + 参数），支持自选风格、出图张数与成品形态。
